article_notes: 22 B. canis dogs grouped by age (11 young vs 11 adult), sampled at admission and 14 days after imidocarb. Groups are defined by age, not by severity or outcome; the comparisons are of vital signs, clinical signs, haematology, proteins and lipids between age groups and over time. No severity or outcome definition, so nothing was extracted (age is the grouping variable, not tested against a severity measure). The authors speculate that young dogs had a more intense acute phase response (heart rate higher in young dogs, p=0.020; triglycerides lower), but no severity measure was defined.
